sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent run. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, with strong recent form of five wins in their last six outings. Alsager arrive as one of the division's struggling sides, sitting second-bottom with just 4 points and on a difficult run with one win in their last six.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away in a match that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach, with Stafford on mixed recent form (draw-win) while Dawley have shown some upturn. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two teams around the promotion picture, though Bridgnorth are fresher after a recent win. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a basement-area encounter, with Casuals performing better recently. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a contest between mid-table sides, both capable performers this season. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between struggling sides, with New Mills slightly better placed but both searching for consistency. Shawbury United visit Barnton in a clash of inconsistent teams, while Crewe face Allscott Heath in a basement battle. Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the division's poorest side with just 2 points—offering Brereton a genuine opportunity to climb the table. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the league's lowest performers.
